head: 86a123a84387fc7f59e0a2ba6fcd5eb83130c514
classification_reasons: Spec is tight (R1-R16 measurable, both flagged concerns closed by panel #1 and #2), but the blast radius is not small: a new public API name in app.backtest.__all__, a new CLI entry point that does network and cache I/O through load_klines, and three new modules/test files.
The build edits a test file already on main (tests/test_backtest.py::test_public_api), a recorded departure from spec R14 and the intent's Constraints; that alone takes it out of routine.
The new code is not covered by existing tests; it is covered only by the 19 new tests, which the runner, not this session, will run on HEAD.
attempted: Intent: the diff delivers `python -m app.backtest run SYMBOL INTERVAL START END [--market] [--fast] [--slow] [--fee] [--cache-dir]`, an SMA-crossover strategy function next to the engine, the eight-line output with buy-and-hold, and every refusal the intent lists (request checks, lengths, fee, too few candles, KlineGapError, DownloadError). Nothing out of scope (no second strategy, no shorts, no saved output) was added.

Spec and plan: R1-R13 each map to code in app/backtest/strategy.py and app/backtest/__main__.py; the check order in _run matches spec Design (make_request, lengths, fee, load_klines, height <= slow, strategy, buy-and-hold). Diff files equal plan.md 'Files that change' after the build's plan update; order of work matches the commit sequence (strategy+tests, export, CLI+tests, verifier).

Build departure (tests/test_backtest.py): verified on main that test_public_api asserts set(app.backtest.__all__) equals exactly five names, so spec R1/Acceptance ('sma_cross_positions in __all__') and R14/intent ('no test file on main is edited') cannot both hold; the design missed it. The edit adds one name to the expected set and changes nothing else; the equality stays exact and every other assertion is untouched, so nothing is weakened. change_type is feature, so REVIEW.md's fix-type test-lock rule does not apply, and plan.md records the departure, its reason and the revert path in Risks and Files that change. Judged acceptable: it follows the intent's outcome ('the strategy function joins the public API') over its process constraint; the owner sees it in the PR and can choose the alternative recorded in plan.md.

Proof: no test.log/build.log/lint.log exist yet and verifier.md says 'read, not run' (CI session, SDLC_GATE_COMMANDS=runner); per the deferred-to-runner rule this is not missing proof. verifier.md exercised the changed behavior directly (success output with numbers cross-checked against run_backtest, cache reuse, futures, every refusal, help screens, neighbouring app.data download) and found all 18 Proof test names plus test_run_reports_unusable_cache_dir in the new files.

Tests could pass with the bug present? Checked: an off-by-one or min_samples < window is caught by test_warm_up_rows_are_flat ([1..6], fast 2 slow 4: a part-filled slow SMA would give 1 at row 2); '>=' instead of '>' is caught by test_equal_smas_give_flat on exact integer ties; a lookahead (e.g. centered window or shift(-1)) is caught by test_positions_ignore_later_closes for every k; the engine handoff is pinned by a hand-computed -0.5 return. The CLI success test derives its expected numbers from the same functions but also pins the header text and 22-char line widths; the verifier's independent numbers back it. Fee refusals assert calls == [] (panel #1); boundary 24/23 pins panel #2.

Claims against today's code: inputs._check_fee(fee) exists, returns float, refuses bool/non-number and not 0 <= fee < 1 (so nan and inf are refused) with the message the tests expect; app.data exports DownloadError, Fetch, KlineGapError, load_klines, and `from app.data import loader` imports the submodule, so the clock fixture's monkeypatch of loader.utc_now applies; params.make_request(symbol, interval, start, end, market, today) returns KlineRequest(symbol, interval, market, start: date, end: date), and load_klines accepts date start/end with keyword market, cache_dir, fetch; MARKETS = ('spot', 'futures'); app/data/__main__.py's parser lines and its OSError hint are mirrored verbatim; tests/conftest.py's clock depends on sleeps, so the 503 retry test does not wait; kucoin_stub has KuCoin.add_spot, refuse, calls, SPOT_1H and NOW 2026-10-03 as the tests use.

Blast radius: app/data/, engine.py, inputs.py, summary.py, app/__init__.py, pyproject.toml, ci.yml, conftest, stub and fixtures untouched in the diff. Only existing production file edited is app/backtest/__init__.py (one import, one __all__ entry, docstring); importing strategy there adds only a polars import, no cycle (strategy imports inputs only). No guardrail file (.claude/**, CLAUDE.md, REVIEW.md, sdlc.yaml, policies/**) in the diff. Risk-list hits: none.

Policies: security-baseline rule 2 - every argument checked before use (make_request, _length/validate_lengths, _fee/_check_fee) and before any fetch; no eval/exec/pickle/shell; the only network path is load_klines's existing one. ux-and-brand - one 'error:' line on stderr, exit 2, no stack trace; note and labels are module constants. coding-standards - type hints on public functions, one module per job, no new dependency, no numpy. CLAUDE.md becomes outdated (opening paragraph, app/backtest/ Architecture bullet) but plan.md names the lines for the owner, as the intent asks; not a build-phase defect.

Edge cases tried on reading: NaN closes would compare as greater in polars and give position 1, but run_backtest's _check_prices refuses non-finite prices, so the CLI path cannot trade on them (direct callers of sma_cross_positions with NaN closes are outside the spec); an empty frame cannot reach the strategy from the CLI because height <= slow refuses it; int() accepting ' 3' or '1_0' is harmless.
Skip markers: none added in the diff (no pytest.mark.skip/skipif/xfail in tests/test_strategies.py or tests/test_backtest_cli.py); nothing to declare.
Drive: not applicable; the plan lists no drive files and this change adds none.
